newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa shares top gainer in IBIS trade.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa shares top gainer in IBIS trade.

text.p: Shares in German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG gained over three percent in pre-bourse trade on Wednesday amid speculation that it planned to spin off its scheduled passenger business into a separate subsidiary.

A source close to the airline said that Lufthansa planned to place its scheduled services in a separate division. But the source said Lufthansa did not plan to spin off its scheduled services into a subsidiary.
Lufthansa shares were up 77 pfennigs at 22.97 marks, a gain of 3.47 percent, compared to the overall market which was up 0.68 percent at 3,088.29 points.
